name: q8_fly_reservoir_output_read
parent_line: fly-connectome ladder (routing enforced v3: action-surface read)
purpose: Read bottleneck sharpened to the biological ACTION surface: the readout sees only the 2,333 output-class neurons (vnc_motor 708, descending 1,314, cb_motor 107, endocrine/efferent 204) - 1.4 percent of the population and 64x scarcer than the interneuron surface. Injection stays on the 15,912 sensory neurons. Write and read surfaces are disjoint AND the read is scarce: every bit of task information must be routed through the frozen wiring onto a tiny output population.

training.trained: sensory input projection (128->15,912), output weighted readout (2,333->128), tied embedding

falsifiable_expectation: Sharper read competition should force stronger routing specialization: if NLL reaches the routed-interneuron arm's level or better, the scarce action-surface read is sufficient; wiring perturbation probes must show large nonzero deltas (the only pathway).
